name: deferred-profile-boundary
goal: Initialization observations never stand in for deferred object operations; retain real data initialization profiles.

evidence: Importing a registered object with a method, nested arrow or Map-held callback emits a successful initialization profile without invoking its deferred work. Keep genuine Map/data initialization eligible and reject import-only callable evidence.

The existing source-profile runner data case covers only a Map of numbers, failed initialization and types. Extend that same standard matrix with nested plain data, methods, nested arrows, Map callbacks, getters and nested classes. Assert scope observations only for actual data initialization; do not call deferred work in the import-only cases.
